editorial:
Attack of the 50 Foot Woman is a Woolner Bros. Pictures production released by Allied Artists on May 18, 1958. Nathan H. Juran directed it under the credit Nathan Hertz, Mark Hanna wrote the screenplay, and Ronald Stein composed the score. The Internet Archive item describes the plot: Hayes meets a satellite on Route 66, grows to title size, and seeks revenge on her philandering husband and his girlfriend.

The rights trap is that a copy being easy to find online proves nothing. A 1958 release is not free by age alone. It depends on whether the film carried a valid notice and whether the copyright was renewed in the 1985-1987 window. I could not check either point here, and the Internet Archive item carries no license or copyright statement. Treat the print as unresolved until you have checked the renewal records yourself.
faq: Is Attack of the 50 Foot Woman (1958) in the public domain?

Not established here. A 1958 film is free only if it lacked a valid notice or its copyright was not renewed in the 1985-1987 window. I could not verify either, so check the Catalog of Copyright Entries renewal volumes and the Copyright Office public records (publicrecords.copyright.gov) before relying on it.
Can I reuse the Internet Archive copy?

Being hosted there is not a rights clearance. The item's metadata has no license or copyright statement. Confirm the renewal status first, and treat the score, story and any restored or re-released versions as separate questions.
